lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 9 visible vertical white lines; spacing is progressively wider in the central torso area and compacts towards the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The three anterior lines terminate in the upper dorsal region; the two posterior-most lines are fragmented into a series of white dots.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A dense grouping of approximately 12 high-contrast spots is concentrated on the lateral haunch above the hind leg junction.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal sequence of four spots is aligned mid-thigh, with a separate diagonal alignment of three spots near the dorsal-posterior curve.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a spiral lyrate path, diverging posteriorly and laterally from the skull before arching medially toward the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 2.3 times the pixel width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately the upper 15% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the orbital regions and two distinct white circular spots on the lower cheek area.
